timefully.config.title: Timefully
timefully.config.layout_mode.tooltip: Grouped moves real time, in-game time and weather together as one block. Separated lets you place each one anywhere on screen on its own.
timefully.config.position.description: To move the widget, bind a key for "Move Timefully widget" in Options, Controls, then press it in game and drag. In Separated mode every shown element gets its own drag handle.
timefully.config.no_cloth: Install Cloth Config for the full settings screen.
timefully.config.no_cloth_colors: Custom colours and background need Cloth Config too.
timefully.config.background_mode.tooltip: Standard follows the day cycle automatically. Single colour uses one fixed colour always. Custom per phase lets you set a colour for each of dawn, day, dusk and night.
timefully.config.background_color.toolti: Used when background mode is set to Single colour.
Used when background mode is set to Custom per phase.
timefully.reposition.title: Move Timefully widget
timefully.reposition.hint: Drag the widget to move it. Press Escape when done.
timefully.reposition.nothing_shown: Every component is switched off, so there is nothing to place.
